-- | A shopping cart: items with prices, discounts and tax.
--
-- Carts are immutable; every function returns a new cart.
module Shop.Cart
  ( Cart (..)
  , Item (..)
  , emptyCart
  , addItem
  , subtotal
  , total
  ) where

import Data.List (find, foldl')
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

-- | One line of a cart.
data Item = Item
  { sku :: String
  , price :: Int
  , qty :: Int
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data Cart = Cart
  { items :: [Item]
  , discount :: Int
  , country :: String
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

rates :: Map.Map String Double
rates = Map.fromList [("PL", 0.23), ("DE", 0.19), ("US", 0.0)]

emptyCart :: String -> Cart
emptyCart c = Cart { items = [], discount = 0, country = c }

-- | Adds an item; a second add of the same sku bumps the quantity.
addItem :: String -> Int -> Int -> Cart -> Cart
addItem s p q cart =
  case find ((== s) . sku) (items cart) of
    Nothing -> cart { items = items cart ++ [Item s p q] }
    Just _ -> cart { items = map bump (items cart) }
  where
    bump it
      | sku it == s = it { qty = qty it + q }
      | otherwise = it

-- | Sum of line totals before discount and tax.
subtotal :: Cart -> Int
subtotal cart = foldl' (\acc it -> acc + price it * qty it) 0 (items cart)

total :: Cart -> Double
total cart =
  let base = max 0 (subtotal cart - discount cart)
      rate = Map.findWithDefault 0 (country cart) rates
      raw = fromIntegral base * (1 + rate)
  in fromIntegral (round (raw * 100)) / 100

class Priced a where
  unitPrice :: a -> Int
  lineTotal :: a -> Int -> Int
  lineTotal x n =
    let p = unitPrice x
        d = if n >= 10 then p `div` 10 else 0
    in (p - d) * n

instance Priced Item where
  unitPrice = price
